# Luis Cabrera

Software engineering and agentic systems.

Software engineer at P&G. I build mobile apps with Flutter/Dart and agentic systems. Warsaw.

- GitHub: https://github.com/luisecab
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/luisecab/
- Website: https://www.luiscabrera.me/

## About

I'm a software engineer at P&G in Warsaw, building mobile apps with Flutter and Dart. Before that I spent five years in product and operations roles at Mercado Libre, a logistics SaaS company and P&G, most recently as a product manager on Pampers messaging and CRM.

Most of my building now happens around AI agents. I run a self-hosted agent (Hermes), built FotoReady, an image pipeline for marketplace sellers on React, Supabase, Gemini and Cloudflare Workers, and work on Adoptsi (https://adoptsi.si), which brings AI agents to legacy businesses. Smaller projects include a Garmin data puller and dashboard and a CLI learning coach.

I have an MSc in Big Data & Advanced Analytics from SGH (2025). I'm interested in agentic engineering: how to make agents reliable, testable and cheap enough to use every day.

- Integrate the app with backend APIs and work on reliability and performance.

**Product Manager**, 2023 - 2025
- Defined the multi-year global CRM Product Vision for Pampers and converted it into a technical roadmap for Braze/Segment integration to improve lifecycle orchestration and CLTV outcomes.
- Owned the yearly messaging vision budget for Pampers, aligning investment decisions with roadmap priorities, delivery capacity, and expected ROI.
- Led the proof of concept for API campaign automation, laying the foundations for an agentic-agency operating model and faster campaign execution.
- Engineered scalable event ingestion and API architecture, reducing API load by 1,200 bps and improving platform reliability for millions of global users.
- Established global standards for data governance, retention logic, and campaign measurement, improving campaign creation speed by 1,000 bps.
- Media Optimization: led predictive scoring initiatives and real-time Power BI/GCP dashboards that improved media investment decisions and increased incremental ROAS by 10% on the annual media spend budget.
- Unified cross-region analytics workflows into one reporting model, improving metric transparency and prioritization speed.
- Orchestrated multi-market requirements for an MVP campaign-management in-housing transformation.
